title: Mistral Large 2 Release
summary: Mistral AI released Mistral Large 2 on July 24, 2024, a 123B-parameter model with a 128k context window and open weights under the Mistral Research License.
significance: A dated release milestone in Mistral AI's large-model line, with first-party release evidence and independently maintained official model documentation.

verification.note: Mistral AI's first-party announcement is dated July 24, 2024 and states that Mistral Large 2 has 123B parameters, a 128k context window, and is released under the Mistral Research License. Official Mistral model documentation independently records July 24, 2024, model identifier mistral-large-2407, 123B parameters, 128k context, and MRL. No development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, priority claim, or relationship edge is inferred.
